newsitem.title: USA: Micron Elec sees Q3 hurt by PC cuts.
newsitem.headline: Micron Elec sees Q3 hurt by PC cuts.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc Tuesday said third quarter financial results are likely to be hurt by recent price reductions in personal computer systems and higher start up costs overseas.
In a statement issued after the market had closed, Micron Electronics said it expects PC sales for the third fiscal quarter will be approximately 10 percent below sales in the second fiscal quarter.

The company currently expects its overall gross margin percentage for the third fiscal quarter ending May 29 will be between two and three percentage points lower than levels experienced in the second fiscal quarter, primarily as a result of recent price reductions on PC Systems.
Start-up costs for international operations, primarily in Japan, will also adversely impact third fiscal quarter earnings.
In March, Micron Electonics reported a second quarter gross margin of around 18 percent.

The company reported net sales of $510.3 million in the second fiscal quarter of 1997. Second quarter net income was $27.8 million and earnings per share were $0.30. For the third fiscal quarter of 1996, net sales totaled $412.3 million, net income was $14.1 million and earnings per share were $0.15.
The company said it expects to announce results for the third fiscal quarter of 1997 in mid-June. Micron Electronics is a unit of Micron Technology Inc.
Shares of Micron Electronics were off 5-3/8 to 18-5/8.

Micron Electronics' second quarter sales of $510.2 million included about $410 million from sales of PC Systems. Based on Micron Electronics' forecast, the company would be projecting third quarter PC sales of about $369 million.
